text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Festivities worthy of the Mejiro name.
And I
must also put on a genuine display
of true
hospitality...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SLAM!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, my apologies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was just a little caught up in my
thoughts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Heya, McQueen! Whoa, why so
serious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've been tasked with greeting an
international
visitor as the Umamusume
representative of the
Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've spent such a long time trying to
compose a
speech that will do justice to
the Mejiro name,
and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I getcha. I heard there's gonna be
a party
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
M'kay, come with me! Oh, and you might
as well
tag along too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The more the merrier! Please? I
think you'd
be a big help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So actually, I got some tickets for a
baseball
game, but I've been strugglin'
to decide who to
go with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Baseball, at a time like this? No, I must
fulfill my
duties as a Mejiro before—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm a prim and proper daughter of
the
Mejiro family too. Although
admittedly I don't
spend much time at
home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I think those experiences away from home are what helped me rediscover what makes me me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You might learn something by throwing
caution
to the wind and sneaking out
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're a bit of a special case,
wouldn't you
say? I doubt I would be
granted leniency if I were
to run away
from my duties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You sure about that? 'Cause I'm pretty
sure
Grandma wants all of us Mejiros to
be happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You know about that uncaught third
strike rule in
baseball, right? Where the
batter gets to run to
first base when
they'd usually get struck out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you could look at it like that.
You know,
turn a crisis into an
opportunity by running away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You might be in a real sticky situation
right now,
but if you put your head
down and run, you might
just run into
something new.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I suppose running away in such a fashion
may be
acceptable. However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's more than acceptable—it's
exceptional! Come
on, run far, far away
and clear that head of yours!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Besides, I know you've got things under control, so you can run away!
choice_data_list: 今日だけでも思いっきり逃げよう
マイペースは大事かもしれない

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Very well. If you insist, then I shall also
allow
myself to have some fun today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: BRING 'EM HOME, YU-TA-KA!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Round the base! Keep going! Keep
going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying a breather at the baseball
game,
Mejiro McQueen fulfills her
important duties.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's always super important to go
your own
way!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides, everyone knows you're super
serious.
Heck, that's what makes you so
cool.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well... I suppose I could not fulfill my
duties if I
were to overwhelm myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: THAT'S THE WAY, YU-TA-KA!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah, now you're gettin' pumped! That's the McQueen I know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen benefits from the
change of
pace and embodies the best
version of herself
when she gives her
speech.
